name: coop-p2-splitscreen
expected: The title/file-select timeline selects the existing save before pressing A.
P2 Start creates the dog and the dog remains usable.
The scene is single while Link and the dog are framed together.
Moving the dog away produces two scene panels and one HUD.
Returning the dog and pressing Start beside Link merges to one view.
The probe records split_count and merge_count at least 1 and ui_passes 1.
